status: Milestone 1 design targets; no production integration changed or certified

classes.A: canonical primitive exists; implementation still needs end-to-end verification
classes.D: material source, policy or provider responsibility

capabilities.feature: Product, variant, media, price and availability
capabilities.acceptance: Exact product/variant identity persists through server cart and owned order; stock and totals come from server
Explicit selected version survives catalog→install→editor→save→preview→publish→immutable release; existing drafts/releases preserved

capabilities.feature: Typed electronics facts and safe public projection
capabilities.owner: commerce-core + shared-types + gateway products + canonical Liquid binding
capabilities.acceptance: Validate fields, save/read back, allowlist public projection, escape text, preserve absent facts, no private supplier metadata leak

capabilities.owner: existing gateway public-product query + storefront adapter
capabilities.acceptance: Real tenant-bound query with indexed allowlisted predicates, actual counts and bounded pagination; no-result preserves query; remove one retains others; hidden until fully wired

capabilities.feature: Compatibility source and explicit unknown state
capabilities.owner: commerce-core factual contract + merchant source responsibility
capabilities.acceptance: Known support tied to specific device-model reference and source date; no model/reference means unconfirmed; connector shape never implies universal compatibility

capabilities.feature: Unit normalization and static model reference
capabilities.owner: commerce-core typed unit validation + facts presentation
capabilities.acceptance: 5 Gb/s→5000 Mb/s, 0.10 m→100 mm; input W and pass-through W remain different fields; missing or different measurements marked not supplied/incomparable

capabilities.feature: Canonical server cart and hosted checkout
capabilities.owner: checkout-core + gateway cart/checkout + commerce checkout origin
capabilities.acceptance: Server repricing, stock/rate eligibility, idempotent retry, no duplicate order; branding via approved data-only contract; mock fixture badge is not live provider evidence

capabilities.feature: Buyer sign-in, registration and explicit continuation
capabilities.acceptance: Email/password(min8 register), configured bot verification, identity-issued session, explicit Continue to Circuit, validated destination; no mandatory email-verification link or invented consent field
Buyer ownership on direct order URLs and mutations; store-scoped orders; profile/address edits persist/read back; invalid PIN retains input; default selection uses actual supported API

capabilities.owner: existing product query + typed facts owner if implemented
capabilities.acceptance: Absent from the customer mockup until normalized values, visibility, bounded compare query, selection/removal and mobile table contract work

capabilities.feature: Financing, installation booking, service subscriptions, automatic compatibility detector, universal warranty guarantees
capabilities.acceptance: Excluded; no controls or promises in this pack

sharedRequests: One centrally owned electronics fact schema and public projection, not a new Product DTO
One current-query extension for typed facets and pagination
Unit normalization helper with dimension semantics
Approved data-only branding consumption and existing BuyerAuthorize return wiring
implementationGate: Wait for coordinator Milestone 1 completion dispatch after all nine packs pass; no production changes during this pack
